newsitem.title: USA: Keithley sees Q1 results below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Keithley sees Q1 results below expectations.

text.p: Keithley Instruments Inc said on Wednesday its sales and earnings for the first quarter of fiscal 1997, which ended Dec 31, would be below expectations.

In a statement, the company said, "The continued poor market conditions in the semiconductor capital equipment industry and lower-than-expected shipments from the company's other divisions resulted in a sales shortfall for the quarter."

Sales in the quarter were $27.9 million, six percent below last year's $29.8 million. The lower sales caused a net operating loss estimated from $0.11 to $0.12 a share, compared with last year's first quarter net income a share of $0.15.
The company had expected earnings to be near break even for the quarter.

"Signs of improvement in the semiconductor capital equipment industry are beginning to appear and we expect improvements in our other businesses; however, we continue to be cautious about the next quarter or two," said Joseph Keithley, the chairman, president and chief executive.
